dish_name_kh: ស្ងោរគ្រឿងជ្រក់និងស្បែកជ្រូក
dish_name_en: Sngor Pickled Cabbage and Pork Skin Soup

ingredients.raw_kh: ស្បែកជ្រូក
ឆ្អឹងជំនីជ្រូកខ្ចី
ស្លឹកខ្ទឹម

steps.text_kh: ស្បែកលាងទឹកឱ្យស្អាត កាត់ប្រវែងមួយថ្នាំងដៃ ឆ្អឹងជំនីជ្រូកលាងឱ្យស្អាត កាប់ដុំៗ យកទៅស្លឱ្យផុយ
steps.text_en: Wash the pork skin and cut finger-length; wash and cut the young ribs; simmer the ribs until tender.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Sngor Pickled Cabbage and Pork Skin Soup, step 1: Wash the pork skin and cut finger-length; wash and cut the young ribs; simmer the ribs until tender.

steps.text_kh: ទើបដាក់ស្បែកជ្រូកចូល ជ្រំអំពិលបន្តិច ដាក់អំបិល ស្ករ ចាក់ទឹកត្រី ម្សៅស៊ុប ភ្លក់មើលឱ្យល្មម
steps.text_en: Add the pork skin, ripe tamarind, salt, sugar, fish sauce, and soup powder; taste and adjust.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Sngor Pickled Cabbage and Pork Skin Soup, step 2: Add the pork skin, ripe tamarind, salt, sugar, fish sauce, and soup powder; taste and adjust.

steps.text_kh: ហាន់ស្លឹកខ្ទឹម វ៉ាន់ស៊ុយវែងៗល្មម មុនដាក់ត្រូវបង់ស្លឹកខ្ទឹម វ៉ាន់ស៊ុយចូលសិន
steps.text_en: Slice lemongrass and green onion; add both to the soup just before serving.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Sngor Pickled Cabbage and Pork Skin Soup, step 3: Slice lemongrass and green onion; add both to the soup just before serving.
